result.topic_en: Latin notes, a draft for the Paris prize essay on heat conduction (Commentatio), defining the second variations of the quadratic form, the cosine of the angle and the area of the infinitesimal triangle formed by ds and δs, and an expression for the curvature measure of an n-dimensional space in a given surface direction.
result.transcription:
sunt, [-et-] quae non mutatur, mutatis variabilibus quolibet modo.
[-Aeq-] Aequationum 5. 6 loco haec assumere possumus:
$dd\,\sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} = [-\sum_{\iota\iota'}-]\ \frac{1}{2}\left( dd\sum a_{\iota\iota'} \delta x_\iota \delta x_{\iota'} + \delta\delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} - 2\, d\delta \sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta x_{\iota'} \right)$
$2\,[-( d\delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta x_{\iota'} - \delta\delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} )-]$
reliquae denique conditiones hoc modo exhiberi possunt, denotando $\delta'$ variationem quamcunque.
$\delta' \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} = \sum a_{\iota\iota'}\, d\delta' x_\iota\, dx_{\iota'} + \sum a_{\iota\iota'}\, dx_\iota\, d\delta' x_{\iota'}$
$d \sum a_{\iota\iota'} \delta' x_\iota \delta x_{\iota'} = \sum a_{\iota\iota'}\, \delta d\delta' x_\iota\, dx_{\iota'}$ [?]
$\delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta' x_{\iota'} = \sum a_{\iota\iota'}\, dx_\iota\, d\delta' x_{\iota'}$ [?]
unde:
$\delta' \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} - d \sum a_{\iota\iota'} \delta' x_\iota dx_{\iota'} - \delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta' x_{\iota'} = 0$
et posito $d = \delta$:
$\delta' \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} - 2\, d \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta' x_{\iota'} = 0$
$\delta' \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} - 2\, \delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta' x_{\iota'} = 0$
unde variationes secundi gradus [-p-] hoc modo determinantur:
[-$2\sum_\iota b_{\iota\iota'}\, d\delta x_\iota$-] $2\sum_\iota a_{\iota\iota'}\, dd x_\iota = - \sum_{\iota\iota'} p_{\iota\iota'\iota''}\, dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}$
$2\sum_\iota a_{\iota\iota''}\, \delta\delta x_\iota = - \sum_{\iota\iota'} p_{\iota\iota'\iota''}\, \delta x_\iota \delta x_{\iota'}$
$2\sum_\iota a_{\iota\iota''}\, d\delta x_\iota = - \sum_{\iota\iota'} p_{\iota\iota'\iota''}\, dx_\iota \delta x_{\iota'}$
hae autem aequationes introductis variabilibus quibuslibet eadem lege formatae sunt. —
Iam sit

Expressio
$\frac{\sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta x_{\iota'}}{ds\, \delta s} = \cos\vartheta$

Erit itaque $\frac{-\frac{3}{4}\frac{1}{2}\, dd\sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'}}{\Delta^2} = \frac{1}{\ldots}\ \ldots$ [?]

methods.what: Expression of the second variation of the quadratic form, replacing equations 5, 6 (curvature-type combination)
methods.quote: $dd\,\sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} = [-\sum_{\iota\iota'}-]\ \frac{1}{2}\left( dd\sum a_{\iota\iota'} \delta x_\iota \delta x_{\iota'} + \delta\delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} - 2\, d\delta \sum_{\iota\iota'} a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta x_{\iota'} \right)$

methods.what: Conditions on variations under an arbitrary variation δ', giving the geodesic-type relations
methods.quote: $\delta' \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota dx_{\iota'} - d \sum a_{\iota\iota'} \delta' x_\iota dx_{\iota'} - \delta \sum a_{\iota\iota'} dx_\iota \delta' x_{\iota'} = 0$

methods.what: Determination of second-order variations via Christoffel-type coefficients p
methods.quote: $2\sum_\iota a_{\iota\iota''}\, d\delta x_\iota = - \sum_{\iota\iota'} p_{\iota\iota'\iota''}\, dx_\iota \delta x_{\iota'}$

methods.what: Line elements defined by the metric quadratic form
